## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat(combobox): …`), it becomes the changelog entry
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including keyboard and ARIA behaviour
- [ ] Docs page and demo updated
- [ ] Checked with a screen reader (NVDA or VoiceOver) for new or changed interactions
